facts.business: N G Industries Ltd is engaged in the business of healthcare through its divisions N G Medicare & Calcutta Hope Infertility Clinic, N G Nursing Home and N G Pharmacy.
key_risks: Slowing economy reducing discretionary spending on elective and non-urgent care
Reputational exposure inherent to healthcare delivery
Retaining experienced clinical and support staff
Sustaining referral relationships with independent doctors
Rising crude oil prices and Rupee depreciation increasing costs on imported equipment, diagnostic reagents/consumables and logistics fuel
Change in West Bengal State Government may bring shifts in health-sector regulation, insurance schemes or public health programmes
Healthcare sector subject to regulatory or tariff-related interventions
Litigation and public unrest directed at healthcare institutions
facts.related_party_note: All contracts/arrangements/transactions entered by the Company during the financial year with related parties were in the ordinary course of business and on an arm's length basis. The Company had not entered into any contracts/arrangements/transactions with related parties which could be considered material in accordance with the policy of the Company on materiality of related party transactions.
